title: TerraGuard policy (.terraguard.yml)
description: Engineering standards as code: gate threshold, budgets, overrides, waivers and custom rules.

attribute.description: Dotted path into the resource, e.g. tags.owner or metadata_options.http_tokens.

in.description: Value must be one of these.

not_in.description: Value must not be any of these.

matches.description: Value must match this regular expression (RE2).

not_matches.description: Value must not match this regular expression (RE2).

contains.description: List element, map key or substring that must be present.

extends.description: Policy packs to inherit, base first: relative paths or https URLs. Later files override earlier ones.

max_findings.description: Risk budget: the gate fails when a severity exceeds its count.

disable.description: Rule IDs or globs (TG-CF-*) to turn off.

severity_overrides.description: Rule ID or glob mapped to a new severity.

resource.description: Resource address or glob; empty means any.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Expired waivers re-activate the finding and raise TG-POL-001.

owner.description: Team that owns this standard; shown on every finding.

resource_types.description: Resource type globs, e.g. aws_* or aws_db_instance.

where.description: The rule applies only to resources matching every condition.

assert.description: Every condition must hold, or a finding is raised.
